title: Resolve build errors and leak paths
summary: Use build diagnostics and imported Radiant pointfiles to locate problems.
outcome: A corrected map ready for another build.

sections.title: Follow a build error

steps.title: Read the log
steps.text: Keep the build window open and read the first actionable error in Build log. Use View → Console output for editor diagnostics. When an object location appears, choose Show in map to select and frame it.

steps.title: Fix the cited input
steps.text: Correct the reported brush, entity field, material, model, or missing raw asset. Reopen the build and compile again after changing the map.

tips: If Show in map says the object is no longer selectable, inspect visibility and rebuild; the diagnostic refers to the document state used by that build.
Native glass limits may require smaller panes or fewer distinct glass combinations.

sections.title: Inspect an existing leak pointfile

steps.title: Import evidence
steps.text: Choose View → Import leak path (.lin)… and select a Radiant pointfile with one X Y Z position per line.

steps.title: Trace the route
steps.text: Use the leak controls to step between points and frame the current point. Inspect nearby sealing geometry and correct the opening.

tips: Import displays a supplied leak path; the editor does not detect leaks by itself.
